title: Meno tenant course groups (groups.yml)
description: A tenant's own groupings of their courses - display organization for the app's course list, nothing more. Canonical prose definition: .agents/skills/second-brain/references/vault-conventions.md. Membership is by course slug and is orthogonal to where a course directory sits on disk; a course named by no group is Ungrouped, derived by diffing this file against the tree walk. Array order is display order.

id.description: kebab-case, derived from the title at creation and stable afterwards - a rename changes the title, never the id

items.description: a course slug as course.yml declares it, not a directory path
